buildings.name: NaturalTile
buildings.description: Fill that hole you dug out back in with any solid element.
buildings.effect: Fills a block in the world with Solids.
buildings.notes: Buildable from any Solid element. On construction complete, the building deletes itself and places a natural block of the chosen element (mass = BlockMass) in the cell, displacing pickupables. Option-dependent (config.json next to DLL, defaults used here): BuildMass=50 -> materialMass, BuildSpeed=3 -> constructionTime, BlockMass=50 -> placed block mass. Registered to tech via the tech containing RationBox (FarmingTech in current build); appended to the end of the Base plan menu.
